## 0.2.247

owes: SyncDesk — every destination's screen now carries its body, read from the hub's facts relay: the reader's lists, an article (`handle`, `from`), the sources, home and the catalogue of apps on the device token, `settings.appOff` under the session, and `feeds.settings` (the feeds' health), which now needs a session (`-32016` without one, as a changed default); `ui.page` on a reader list answers the next 30 rows from its `<offset>:<composedAt>` cursor; `ui.act` runs `feeds.readAbove` as `feed.markMany` of exactly the rows above (a search scope is `-32602`), and an action the engine does not run answers `-32601` naming it the web's, with its reason; home's tile and heart sentences arrive in the hub's default language until the module summaries speak in catalogue keys; out of reach every screen answers `-32022`; the web's pages are unchanged; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `ui.screen` now answers the body, read from the hub's facts relay, of every stocks destination: `stocks.board`, `stocks.instrument`, `stocks.alerts`, `stocks.news`, `stocks.newsItem`, `stocks.watchlist` and `stocks.settings` on the device token, and `stocks.import`, which now needs a session (`-32016` without one, as a changed default) and answers its *Upload* state only (a review or report follows a posted statement, never relayed); `ui.page` on the headlines list answers the next rows from its `more` cursor, the other stocks lists are not paged; out of reach they answer `-32022`; the import's empty-form notice is a catalogue key in the model, drawn the same by the web; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `ui.screen` now answers the body, read from the hub's facts relay, of every weather destination: `weather.board`, `weather.place`, `weather.day`, `weather.places` and `weather.settings` on the device token, and `weather.accuracy` and `weather.sensor`, which now need a session (`-32016` without one, as a changed default; the catalogue marks them `needsSession`, so `ui.changed` after `session.changed` names them); `ui.page` on the places list answers all its rows and no `more`; a sensor page asked with `discover` or `check` waits while the hub listens, as the web's page does; out of reach they answer `-32022`; a failed sensor check or discovery is now a catalogue key in the model, drawn the same by the web; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `ui.screen` now answers the body, read on the device token from the hub's facts relay, of every notes destination (`notes.all`, `notes.label`, `notes.archive`, `notes.trash`, `notes.labels`, `notes.search`, `notes.note`, `notes.settings`); `ui.page` on a notes list answers all its rows and no `more` (the notes are never paged); `notes.note` of a readable note is `-32004`, as the web sends it to its list with `edit`; out of reach they answer `-32022`; the web's pages are unchanged; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `ui.screen` now answers the body, read from the hub's facts relay, of `settings`, `settings.interface` and `backups` (on the device token) and of `settings.sync`, `settings.about`, `settings.account`, `settings.totp`, `settings.devices`, `settings.apps`, `settings.users`, `settings.user`, `settings.userNew`, `settings.backup`, `settings.backupRestore`, `settings.broker` and `mqtt` (under the session, then the page's capability); out of reach they answer `-32022`; the account page's *this session* is the engine's own session, and reading the hub backup page through the relay clears a shown restore failure as a page view does; the web's pages are unchanged; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — the hub answers a new route, `GET /api/v1/ui/facts?destination=<id>&<params>` (a page's facts as the interface model's JSON: on the device token for app content, the Settings index, *Interface* and app backups; on a session token, then the page's capability, for the hub-only pages; `destination=pane` answers the switcher's `values`), and `engine/1` gains, additions only, the error `-32022 hubUnreachable` (`ui.screen` and `ui.page` with no body while the hub cannot be reached); `ui.pane` now carries each app's switcher `value` as a `count` text (`nav.count.number`, `nav.count.places`, new in the strings files), absent at 0 and absent while the hub cannot be reached; the web's switcher shows the same counts and, as a changed default, no longer shows `0` for an app that counts nothing (a reader with nothing unread, notes with no live note); no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
